n1.speaker: leslie
n1.text: Oh, this is nice. I don't often have a day off! Did you have a good week?

translations.fa: آه، چه خوب. من زیاد روز تعطیل ندارم! هفتهٔ خوبی داشتی؟

branches.suggestion: Yes, I had a great week, thanks.
branches.suggestionFa: آره، هفتهٔ خیلی خوبی داشتم، ممنون.

branches.suggestion: It was busy. I went to work every day.
branches.suggestionFa: شلوغ بود. هر روز رفتم سر کار.

n2.speaker: leslie
n2.text: Me too. On Wednesday I saw a play with my sister in town. It was brilliant.

translations.fa: منم. چهارشنبه با خواهرم تو شهر یه نمایش دیدم. عالی بود.

branches.suggestion: I love the theatre. Where did you go?

cultureNote.en: British spelling: theatre and centre. American: theater and center.
cultureNote.fa: املای بریتانیایی theatre و centre است.

n3.speaker: leslie
n3.text: We went to the Royal. Then we ate at a little Italian place and I had far too much pudding!

translations.fa: رفتیم تئاتر رویال. بعد تو یه رستوران کوچیک ایتالیایی غذا خوردیم و من زیادی دسر خوردم!

cultureNote.en: In Britain "pudding" often just means dessert: "What's for pudding?"
cultureNote.fa: در بریتانیا pudding اغلب یعنی دسر.

n4.speaker: leslie
n4.text: Tiramisu. Then I bought Nicola some new shoes. She grew two sizes this year!

translations.fa: تیرامیسو. بعد برای نیکولا کفش نو خریدم. امسال دو سایز بزرگ شد!

n5.speaker: leslie
n5.text: She loved them. She wore them to bed! What did you do on Saturday?

translations.fa: عاشقشون شد. با کفش خوابید! تو شنبه چی کار کردی؟

branches.suggestion: I went to the market and bought some fruit.
branches.suggestionFa: رفتم بازار و یه کم میوه خریدم.

branches.suggestion: I met a friend and we had lunch.
branches.suggestionFa: یه دوست را دیدم و ناهار خوردیم.

n6.speaker: leslie
n6.text: That sounds lovely. Ooh — Callum's bringing our coffees. Thank you, Callum!

translations.fa: چه خوب. اوه — کالوم داره قهوه‌هامون را میاره. ممنون کالوم!

n7.speaker: callum
n7.text: There you go, ladies. One flat white, one latte. Did you two have a good weekend?

translations.fa: بفرمایید خانم‌ها. یه فلت‌وایت، یه لاته. آخر هفته خوش گذشت؟

branches.suggestionFa: بد نبود. مال تو چطور بود؟

n8.speaker: callum
n8.text: Grand, thanks. I went to Brighton and got sunburnt — in October!

translations.fa: عالی، ممنون. رفتم برایتون و آفتاب‌سوخته شدم — تو اکتبر!
